description: Registry of activist short seller reports and campaigns tracked across public equities.

campaigns.report_title: A Toxic Silicon Mirage: Enovix's Manufacturing Impossibility and Battery Yield Collapse
primary_allegations: Exaggerated silicon battery energy density and unviable commercial yields
Delays in Fab-1 automated manufacturing line in Fremont
Excessive cash burn relative to commercialization timeline
campaigns.company_rebuttal_summary: Enovix restructured executive team, appointed TJ Rodgers as Executive Chairman, pivoted manufacturing to Fab-2 in Malaysia, and validated Route 1 high-volume samples.
campaigns.thesis_action_rationale: Commercial pivot to Malaysia Fab-2 derisked production, but quarterly cash burn and customer qualification milestones require close quarterly monitoring.

campaigns.report_title: Solid Power: Solid State Science Project Running on Empty
primary_allegations: All-solid-state electrolyte degradation and low cycle life under real automotive conditions
Commercial automotive deployment timeline pushed beyond 2028
Over-reliance on joint development partners BMW and Ford
campaigns.company_rebuttal_summary: Solid Power delivered A-sample cells to BMW for parallel testing, expanded Korean pilot facility, and maintained $350M+ liquid balance sheet runway.
campaigns.thesis_action_rationale: High cash balance provides >3 years runway, but long commercialization horizon caps allocation size.

campaigns.report_title: We Believe PDD Is a Dying Fraud and Temu Is Cleverly Concealed Malware
primary_allegations: Temu mobile application allegedly incorporates unauthorized spyware and data exfiltration
Fabrication of domestic China GMV and merchant take-rates
Unreconciled cash balances in Chinese domestic subsidiaries
campaigns.company_rebuttal_summary: Subsequent quarterly earnings demonstrated massive international revenue and operating profit growth; app security certifications updated.
campaigns.thesis_action_rationale: Market price reacted minimally, and massive free cash flow conversion ($20B+ TTM) confirmed operating leverage.

campaigns.report_title: Long Bitcoin, Short MicroStrategy: Unjustifiable 2.3x Net Asset Value Premium
primary_allegations: MicroStrategy trading at an unsustainable 100%+ premium to underlying Bitcoin holdings
Core enterprise analytics software revenue stagnant and declining
Debt-financed Bitcoin accumulation creating extreme dilution risk if NAV premium compresses
campaigns.company_rebuttal_summary: Management continued executing convertible bond offerings with 0% coupons and buying Bitcoin accretively on per-share BTC Yield basis.
campaigns.thesis_action_rationale: Software revenue is secondary; MSTR acts as an active capital markets vehicle. However, valuation must be disciplined to avoid buying above peak NAV multiple bands.

campaigns.report_title: Super Micro Computer: Fresh Evidence of Accounting Manipulation, Sibling Self-Dealing and Sanctions Evasion
primary_allegations: Undisclosed related-party transactions with CEO family entities Ablecom and Compuware
Improper revenue recognition and premature shipment booking
Rehiring of executives previously implicated in SEC accounting restatement
campaigns.company_rebuttal_summary: Company delayed 10-K filing, appointed special board committee, and later auditor Ernst & Young resigned.
campaigns.thesis_action_rationale: High forensic accounting risk and auditor resignation mandate strict Avoid status until audited financial restatements are filed.
